about: The copy that still carries the retired "2.1" product label, as of the change that retired it
(owner ruling 2026-10-20: the product is "mod_pagespeed"). Two lists, two checks:
counting every use on a built page: visible text, title, description, social metas, alt and
aria-label values, and JSON-LD strings. "sources" is {file: hits} for
test/content-accuracy.test.ts (rule k-retired-2.1-product-label), one hit per matching line.
Both are exact-count ratchets: a count above the entry fails (new text), a count below it fails
until the entry is lowered, and an entry with nothing left fails until it is removed.
What remains is the dated announcement post "mod_pagespeed 2.1: one product again", which keeps
the title it was published under (a record, exempt by file in both checks), and the pages that
show that title: the blog index and the related-post cards of a few posts. The generated
public/llms.txt lists the same title. Delete this file if the title is ever retired.
